newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan panel starts debate on insurance de-control.
newsitem.headline: Japan panel starts debate on insurance de-control.

text.p: A subcommittee of the Insurance Council, an advisory body to Japan's Finance Minister, held its first meeting on Tuesday to work out an interim proposal over measures and procedures Japan should take under the "Big Bang" financial reforms, a council member said.
